name: SWE-PolyBench
intro: SWE-PolyBench 是一个多语言仓库级软件工程基准，包含来自 21 个仓库的 2,110 个实例，覆盖 Java、JavaScript、TypeScript 和 Python。任务由关闭 Issue 且包含测试代码的真实 PR 构建，经历史 Docker 环境、F2P/P2P 测试和可测试性过滤，并同时评测可执行解决率以及文件级、CST 节点级检索能力。
build_method: GitHub PR 挖掘、人工 Docker 配置、F2P/P2P 执行过滤
metric: Pass Rate, File/CST Retrieval Precision & Recall
eval_feature: 多语言、执行式评测、CST 结构检索
scale: 2,110 个实例，21 个仓库，4 种语言
build_method_en: GitHub PR Mining, Manual Docker Configuration, F2P/P2P Execution Filtering
intro_en: SWE-PolyBench is a multilingual repository-level software engineering benchmark with 2,110 instances from 21 repositories in Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python. It mines real pull requests that close issues and add tests, validates them in historical Docker environments with F2P/P2P tests, and evaluates both executable resolution and file- and CST-node-level retrieval.
metric_en: Pass Rate, File/CST Retrieval Precision & Recall

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.08703 Sections 2-3. The diagram follows the four-language repository metadata filters, issue-closing PR and test-code requirement, manually configured historical Docker environments, gold/test patch split, F2P/P2P execution, and the requirement for at least one F2P test. It also records the paper's exclusion of tasks that test newly created files, LLM-assisted task and informativeness annotation, the 500-item stratified subset, and both execution and file/CST retrieval metrics.
